capabilities: Aggregate search, notes, favorites, and recent files into one view
Show vault statistics and a health check with full-disk scan
Display due-date and month calendars with todo markers
Track daily and weekly todos and writing volume
Provide a scratchpad and a box-selectable tag overview
extras: Runs locally with no network requests or dependencies and installs as three files dropped into the vault; the health check can perform a full-disk scan; MIT licensed.
problem: Obsidian's daily tools such as search, tasks, calendars, and stats are scattered across separate views and commands.
summary: Workbench plugin that gathers 14 daily micro-tasks—search, new note, favorites, recent, tasks, stats, calendar, todo—into one view.
